$comment: Identity is frozen by artifacts/design/rule-catalog-v1.md. Performance appears here only where it is experienced as interface behavior; engineering performance work is not this framework's subject (Standard 2).

rules.title: Declared performance budgets are expressed testably
rules.description: Where a project declares performance budgets, they are stated as measurable thresholds against named conditions rather than as adjectives.
rules.rationale: 'Fast' cannot be met or missed. A budget that cannot fail is a preference wearing a budget's clothes.
rules.remediation: State each budget as a metric, a threshold, and the condition it is measured under.
rules.$assuranceNote: Applicable only where budgets are declared. The declaration's shape is checkable; whether the product meets it is a measurement this framework does not perform.

rules.title: Layout does not shift under the user
rules.description: Content arriving after first paint does not displace content the user is already reading or about to act on.
rules.rationale: A shift at the moment of a tap turns an intended action into a different one, and the user is blamed for it by the interface's own logic.
rules.remediation: Reserve space for late-arriving content rather than letting it insert itself.
rules.$assuranceNote: Shift is measured during loading with real timing. Nothing in source establishes it.
